about: GTA stars (Delta, pillar 7 pop culture). Samuel L. Jackson voiced Officer Frank Tenpenny, the corrupt Los Santos cop, in GTA San Andreas (2004; GameSpot cast story Oct 2004, Game Developer 2004-10-25 cast list). Ray Liotta was the voice of Tommy Vercetti in Vice City (2002; Rockstar on X 2022-05-26: 'the iconic voice of Tommy Vercetti'; Game Informer obituary: Goodfellas). Burt Reynolds was in Vice City and argued with Dan Houser over a scene; Reynolds yelled 'Get the limey out of here.' Houser (from London) to Vulture, 2018-10-14: 'we don't bring in name actors anymore because of their egos and, most important of all, because we believe we get a better sense of immersion using talented actors whose voices you don't recognize.' Houser left Rockstar in March 2020; his 2018 words are never applied to GTA 6. GTA VI: Coming November 19, 2026; Jason and Lucia (rockstargames.com/VI). No GTA 6 voice actor is named or implied. Sources in BRIEF.md.
